title: Planner
subtitle: Tell it the goal and the deadline: Nicx builds the steps, spreads the dates up to the deadline and sets a reminder for each one.
hint: In chat or by voice: "make a plan to learn English by December". The plan becomes a project, with the steps as its tasks.
loadFailed: Couldn't load the plans. Is the Nicx server running?
proposeFailed: Couldn't build the steps. Try again.
createFailed: Couldn't create the plan. Try again.
adjustFailed: Couldn't readjust the plan. Try again.
deadlineFailed: Couldn't read the deadline. Pick the date on the calendar.
restartServer: Restart the Nicx server to use the planner.
noLocalModel: No local model loaded. Start Ollama and choose a model.
nothingUsable: The local model didn't return usable steps. Try again or phrase the goal differently.

form.deadlineTextPlaceholder: Or type: by December, in 3 months...
form.deadlineUnknown: I didn't understand that deadline. Pick the date on the calendar.
form.waiting: The local model is building the steps… It can take 30 s to 1.5 min on this PC.
form.needStep: The plan needs at least one step.
form.emptyStep: Write the text of every step or remove the empty ones.

steps.title: Proposed steps
steps.hint: Adjust each step's text and time, remove or add steps. Dates are spread up to the deadline when the plan is created.
steps.name: Plan name (optional)
steps.namePlaceholder: Uses the goal if left empty

created.title: Plan "{{name}}" created
created.summary: {{n}} steps until {{date}}, each with a reminder at 09:00 on its day.

plans.title: Your plans
plans.empty: No plans with a deadline yet.
plans.adjustHint: Readjusting spreads the open steps up to the deadline (or the new one) and replaces the reminders.
